Eve Higher Education Opportunity Program (HEOP) to provide tailored support to students through one-on-one tutoring, skill-building workshops, and other resources. Participer à des initiatives d’amélioration continue.

Support preparation of the book proposal by organizing theoretical frameworks, research findings, chapter concepts, and related project materials.
Research publisher requirements and proposal guidelines, including those of Intellect Publishing and other appropriate academic presses.
Format and organize proposal materials in accordance with publisher submission requirements.
Depending on the final publication strategy, assist with research and organizational support for a potential special issue or edited-volume pathway.
Identify and catalogue potential multidisciplinary scholars and contributors whose work addresses relevant gaps in swimwear scholarship.
Maintain bibliographies, research files, project documentation, and milestone tracking to support the timely development of the project.

Currently enrolled in a graduate program (Master’s or Ph.D.) in Fashion Studies, Art History, Cultural Studies, Sociology, the Humanities, or a closely related field.

title: MSc Thesis Opportunities Through a Summer Internship – Multiple Openings
description:
Job Description Summary
Job Description
Location: Tampere, Finland
GE Vernova’s Grid Solutions business serves customers globally with over 17,000 employees in more than 80 countries. Grid Solutions helps enable the transition to a more reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy system by bringing together advanced technologies and expertise across the power grid value chain. The business provides equipment, systems, and services for the transmission, distribution, and conversion of electricity, supporting utilities and industries in building the grid of the future.
In Tampere, our teams contribute to the development of Flexible AC Transmission Systems (FACTS) and STATCOM solutions, which play an important role in improving power system stability, voltage control, and grid performance. These technologies are essential for integrating renewable energy, increasing transmission efficiency, and supporting the evolving needs of modern power systems.
We are offering several opportunities for students who want to begin with a summer internship and continue with an MSc thesis in the autumn. These positions are intended only for MSc thesis workers following this schedule. The openings are suitable for students in electrical engineering, automation, software engineering, embedded systems, applied AI, or power electronics who are looking to combine practical summer work with a thesis topic that has real business relevance.
When applying, please select the two domains you are most interested in and rank them in priority order. This helps us evaluate your application against the most relevant opportunities.
If you are a more experienced candidate looking for a regular engineering role rather than an MSc thesis opportunity, we kindly ask you to apply for other suitable openings through our jobs portal.
Available Thesis Domains
1) Control Software
In the Control Software domain, the work focuses on the development, testing, and validation of control software for advanced grid and power electronic applications. Typical topics may include control algorithm development, dynamic system modelling, simulation, model-based design, and performance optimization.
Useful knowledge in this area may include:
• MATLAB
• Simulink
• Control theory
• Power system fundamentals
• Software development practices
2) Real Time Digital Simulator (RTDS), Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and Automatic Testing
This domain focuses on real-time simulation, Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing, automated testing, and system verification. Work in this area may include development of test environments, test case automation, HIL setups, and validation of system functionality.
Useful knowledge in this area may include:
• Real Time Digital Simulator (RTDS)
• Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL)
• Automated testing methods
• Scripting or programming skills
• Signal analysis
• Understanding of power systems or control systems
